objective: To implement an automated electrical control system for a banquet hall that manages lights, fans, and ACs based on real-time occupancy detection, eliminating manual intervention after initial setup. The system aims to achieve significant energy savings by ensuring appliances operate only when zones are occupied while maintaining guest comfort during events. Staff will monitor system status through accessible dashboards but will not need to manually control appliances during normal operations.

db_schema_diagram:
erDiagram
    Zone ||--o{ MotionSensor : "contains"
    Zone ||--o{ Appliance : "contains"
    Zone ||--o{ SystemConfiguration : "configures"
    MotionSensor ||--o{ OccupancyEvent : "generates"
    Appliance ||--o{ ApplianceEvent : "records_state_changes"
    Zone {
        uuid zone_id PK
        string zone_name
        json floor_plan_coordinates
        timestamp created_at
        timestamp updated_at
    }
    MotionSensor {
        uuid sensor_id PK
        string zigbee_device_id
        uuid zone_id FK
        date installation_date
        integer battery_level
        timestamp last_seen_at
        string status
    }
    Appliance {
        uuid appliance_id PK
        string appliance_name
        enum appliance_type
        string relay_module_id
        integer gpio_pin
        uuid zone_id FK
        integer power_rating_watts
        enum current_state
    }
    OccupancyEvent {
        uuid event_id PK
        uuid sensor_id FK
        uuid zone_id FK
        enum event_type
        timestamp timestamp
        float confidence_score
    }
    ApplianceEvent {
        uuid appliance_event_id PK
        uuid appliance_id FK
        enum previous_state
        enum new_state
        enum trigger_type
        string triggered_by
        timestamp timestamp
    }
    SystemConfiguration {
        uuid config_id PK
        uuid zone_id FK
        integer occupancy_threshold
        integer turn_on_delay_seconds
        integer turn_off_delay_seconds
        integer stagger_delay_appliances
        boolean is_auto_mode
    }
    StaffUser {
        uuid user_id PK
        string username
        string hashed_password
        enum role
        timestamp last_login
        timestamp created_at
    }
